entry.name: rnbo_pipe
entry.description: Delay incoming numbers for a specified length in milliseconds. If no argument is specified, the initial value is 0 and the delay time is 0 ms. If there is one argument, this sets the delay time. If there are two arguments, the first argument sets an initial value to be stored in pipe, and the second argument sets the delay time. If more than two arguments are present, pipe creates additional inlets and outlets for delaying additional numbers.
